title: Record the empty forward relay for flag 0
body:
## Summary
- Flag 0 leaves basis head 232 at event 591. `Y34` first contains that head at event 3500, when `X0` is already on the coordinate basis.
- The only shared registers are `Q3`, `Q4` and `Q6`. Each meets `Y34` before it meets `X0`, so the forward relay count is zero.
- Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
